greetingOnlyResponse: Hello! Welcome to ResumeCraft. I'll help you build your professional resume. Let's start with your name. What should I call you?
greetingWithNameResponse: Hello {fullName}! Wonderful to meet you. What is your current job, profession or occupation? You can describe it in your own words.
greetingWithNameAndOccupationResponse: Hello {fullName}! Great to meet an {professionalTitle}. Let's get your contact details next.
fresherResponse: Understood! As a fresher, we'll highlight your academic qualifications, skills, and projects while skipping full-time work experience.
normalEmployeeClarification: Could you tell me a bit more about what kind of work you do day-to-day (for example: administration, sales, stock/inventory, customer support, or technical work)?
summaryGuidanceResponse: No worries at all! A resume summary is just a short 2-3 sentence overview highlighting your background and strengths. Based on your role as {professionalTitle}, here are a few tailored options you can pick or customize:
skipAllowedResponse: Skipped this optional step. We can always come back to it later!
skipNotAllowedResponse: This field is required for an ATS-compliant resume so recruiters know how to evaluate or contact you. Please provide your {fieldName} to proceed.
editAcknowledgedResponse: Understood! I've updated your {fieldName} to "{newValue}". Let's continue.
compoundAcknowledgedResponse: Got it! I've saved your details ({fieldsList}).
